# BidSwitch
> BidSwitch is a global programmatic advertising exchange and infrastructure platform connecting buyers and sellers across digital media.

BidSwitch provides supply and demand partners with integrations, marketplace controls, identity and privacy features, reporting, and support resources for programmatic trading.

## Platform
- [Home](https://www.bidswitch.com/): Overview of BidSwitch’s programmatic exchange and marketplace infrastructure.
- [Solutions](https://www.bidswitch.com/solutions/): Summary of platform capabilities for buyers, sellers, and curated marketplace use cases.
- [Buyers](https://www.bidswitch.com/buyers/): Information for DSPs and buying platforms connecting to supply through BidSwitch.
- [Sellers](https://www.bidswitch.com/sellers/): Information for SSPs and publishers monetizing inventory through BidSwitch.
- [Curate](https://www.bidswitch.com/curate/): Details on curated deal packaging and audience-based marketplace workflows.
- [Identity](https://www.bidswitch.com/identity/): Overview of identity interoperability and addressability support across partners.

## Product Capabilities
- [Inventory Discovery](https://www.bidswitch.com/solutions/inventory-discovery/): Explains tools for finding, evaluating, and activating supply opportunities.
- [Traffic Shaping](https://www.bidswitch.com/solutions/traffic-shaping/): Describes controls for optimizing bidstream quality and reducing unnecessary traffic.
- [Deal Management](https://www.bidswitch.com/solutions/deal-management/): Covers workflows for activating and scaling private marketplace deals.
- [Identity Solutions](https://www.bidswitch.com/solutions/identity-solutions/): Describes support for identity frameworks and interoperable addressability signals.
- [CTV](https://www.bidswitch.com/solutions/ctv/): Highlights connected TV supply access and programmatic activation capabilities.
- [Retail Media](https://www.bidswitch.com/solutions/retail-media/): Explains retail media marketplace connectivity and audience activation support.

- [Blog](https://www.bidswitch.com/resources/blog/): News, product updates, thought leadership, and marketplace insights.
- [Case Studies](https://www.bidswitch.com/resources/case-studies/): Customer stories showing platform usage and business outcomes.
- [Webinars](https://www.bidswitch.com/resources/webinars/): On-demand and upcoming sessions about programmatic advertising topics.
- [Reports](https://www.bidswitch.com/resources/reports/): Research and market reports related to digital advertising and curation.
- [Events](https://www.bidswitch.com/resources/events/): Conference appearances, hosted events, and industry engagement information.

## Support
- [Support](https://protocol.bidswitch.com/support): Entry point for partner support and operational assistance.
- [Knowledge Base](https://protocol.bidswitch.com/support/home): Help center for common questions and troubleshooting topics.
- [Contact Support](https://protocol.bidswitch.com/support/tickets/new): Form for submitting support requests to the BidSwitch team.
- [System Status](https://status.bidswitch.com/): Service availability and incident reporting for BidSwitch systems.

## Protocol Documentation
- [Protocol Documentation Home](https://protocol.bidswitch.com/): Main documentation portal for BidSwitch protocol and integration materials.
- [Getting Started](https://protocol.bidswitch.com/getting-started): Introductory guidance for new BidSwitch integrations.
- [OpenRTB Guide](https://protocol.bidswitch.com/openrtb): Documentation on BidSwitch OpenRTB implementation and behavior.
- [Buyer Integration](https://protocol.bidswitch.com/buyers): Technical guidance for integrating as a buying platform.
- [Seller Integration](https://protocol.bidswitch.com/sellers): Technical guidance for integrating as a supply partner.
- [Creative Approval](https://protocol.bidswitch.com/creatives): Requirements and workflows for creative review and approval.
- [Macros](https://protocol.bidswitch.com/macros): Reference for supported macros and token substitution behavior.
- [Error Codes](https://protocol.bidswitch.com/errors): Reference for protocol and platform error handling information.

- [API Documentation](https://protocol.bidswitch.com/api): Overview of available APIs and technical interfaces.

- [Filtering and Targeting](https://protocol.bidswitch.com/targeting): Technical details on targeting parameters and filtering controls.
- [Deal IDs](https://protocol.bidswitch.com/deals): Reference for deal object handling and marketplace transactions.
- [User Sync](https://protocol.bidswitch.com/user-sync): Documentation for cookie sync and identity matching workflows.
